text:
Rhea M: quick design check  axis unit label + smoothing/outlier controls in Console charts. does `/s` read okay on the axis or should we spell `req/s`? panels feel tight when p95 and legends show.
Omar L: `/s` keeps the axis tidy. tooltip can show full text like 'Requests per second (req/s)'.
June K: agree. also the legend gets taller when smoothing is toggled because raw+smoothed show separately. Proposal: when smoothing is on, collapse the raw into a muted single-row with a 'Show raw' affordance.
Carlos P: great. Accessibility: collapsed items must be keyboard-focusable and expose state via aria-expanded and a label like 'Raw series hidden'.
Rhea M: about outliers, PM asked for "reduce noise" mode. Two options: clip values (affects scale) or visually de-emphasize spikes (alpha/stroke). Which is safer?
Omar L: de-emphasize. Clipping can hide real incidents and distort SLA views. Fade keeps values accessible on hover.
June K: microcopy suggestion: label: 'De-emphasize outliers' helper: 'Fade isolated spikes visually; values unchanged.' keeps it short for compact panels.
A11yBot: a11y checklist: 1) Announce toggle state with aria-live, e.g., 'Outlier de-emphasis enabled'. 2) Don't rely on color alone; ensure faded points are keyboard reachable and have visible focus. 3) Add a textual caption line when enabled.
Carlos P: CSS idea for collapsed legend:
``` .legend--muted { color: var(--muted); font-size:12px }
.legend--muted .action { text-decoration: underline }
.legend--muted:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus) } ```
June K: keyboard flow: `G` focus graph, `L` focus legend, arrows navigate, Enter toggles raw. Add to shortcuts modal.
Rhea M: action items: use `/s` on-axis, tooltip 'Requests per second (req/s)' sentence case, label 'De-emphasize outliers' + helper. I'll add prop `deEmphasizeOutliers` and feature flag `console.featureFlags.outlierFade` behind beta. Will post figma and open a PR.
Omar L: please include unit tests for legend keyboard nav and an a11y test asserting aria-live message.
Rhea M: thanks all — will ping when PR is ready.
